.. change::
    :tags: usecase, autogenerate
    :tickets: 916

    Autogenerate now renders a warning comment above any rendered
    :meth:`.Operations.drop_constraint` directive for which the constraint name
    is ``None``, as is the case when a constraint that has no name in the model
    is dropped, most typically within the ``downgrade()`` function of a
    migration that adds an unnamed constraint.  A warning is also emitted on
    the console when the migration script is generated.   The directive
    requires a non-None name in order to be able to emit a "DROP CONSTRAINT"
    command.
